verdict.rationale: Sift's Workflows product explicitly lets ops build custom, score-based rules automation and connect them to real business actions (Ban Account, Cancel Order, etc.), and the Score API delivers a 0-100 risk score that can be split into ranges for allow/review/block-style logic, with Decisions API triggering the chosen action. However, no evidence explicitly mentions a step-up 3DS action or a threshold-tuning UI/appetite-setting workflow. Missing for 10: explicit 3DS step-up action support, evidence of a UI for setting/adjusting score-range thresholds, and independent confirmation of this workflow in practice.
